Calcarea Oxalica.

Calcium Oxalate. Ca C2O4.

Clinical.─Cancer.

Characteristics.─Calc. ox. has been found useful in allaying the pains of cancer.

Relations.─Compare: Acet. ac., Oxal. ac., Citric ac., Euphorb., Euphorb. het.
